metaDescription: Shop custom neoprene pet accessories for your brand. Perfect for giveaways. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Neoprene is the go-to material for pet accessories that need to hold up to daily use and outdoor adventures. Its closed-cell foam structure resists water, dirt, and tearing — ideal for collars, leashes, and the popular Full Color Slap Wrap™. Custom neoprene pet accessories let you print vibrant, full-color logos that stay flexible and won't peel. Whether you're outfitting a charity walk or a pet-friendly office event, neoprene keeps your brand looking sharp through muddy paws and rain.
heroAltText: Custom neoprene pet accessories with full-color logo printed on a Slap Wrap™ collar
